correctness.rationale: The channel difference is a strict trace-norm contraction and geometric renewal expansion gives rho=p sum_n(1-p)^n U^n R U^{-n}. Polynomial projectors from H eigenvalues (-2,0,2,8) make all resonant and nonresonant resolvent expansions explicit. At theta0 the PT matrix A0 has a simple null direction z and remaining eigenvalues 1/2,1/4,1/4. Its first and second perturbations satisfy <z,A1z>=0, <z,A2z>=8c² and <z,A1 A0^+ A1z>=4c²+1/4, so the isolated PT eigenvalue equals p²(4c²-1/4)+O_C(p³), uniformly compact c. Analytic implicit-function theorem at simple limiting roots ±1/4 gives exactly one local entangled interval; other PT eigenvalues stay positive. The exactly resonant rational determinant -p²(1-p)^3/[16(2-p)(1+(1-p)^2)^2] is negative for all 0<p<1. The 2x2 PPT criterion identifies negativity and separability. Independent numerical spectral-projector evaluation at both angles and several p,c confirms the limiting coefficient, not the infinite asymptotic by itself.
residual_risks: The two boundary scalings c=±1/4 have leading coefficient zero; their entanglement status at exactly fixed scaled c is not determined from leading order.
